purpose: Close the missing bridge between an accepted Mem-Gallery dataset audit and real method execution by deterministically loading all 20 source dialogs into the frozen answer-free 1711-QID projection while revalidating source and image identities.

negative_cases: dialog bytes drift after accepted integrity evidence
image bytes drift after accepted integrity evidence

fixed_dataset_identity.question_order: accepted question-index.jsonl and QID_ORDER.txt byte order

preflight_and_projection_rules: require the accepted non-symlink dataset and evidence roots
rehash all four accepted evidence payloads through EVIDENCE_SHA256SUMS
require the dataset root recorded by the accepted evidence to equal the supplied root
rehash the exact source manifest and recompute its canonical identity
require the exact repository revision and frozen path inventory
resolve every scenario only beneath data/dialog without traversal or symlinks
rehash every consumed dialog against its Git blob or LFS identity
adapt all scenarios in the accepted order and validate each query against the frozen answer/question/canonical hashes
reject any returned projection containing a raw answer key
require flattened projection QIDs to equal the accepted 1711-QID order
require projected memory-record count to equal the accepted runner-consumed dialogue-round count
require referenced and unreferenced image partitions to be disjoint complete manifest partitions
rehash all 1490 image files against frozen LFS SHA-256 before returning their allowlist

contains: 1711 frozen question identity rows and QIDs
measured scenario question memory-record and image denominators

next_gate: After WMA release, Mem-Gallery data materialization, and dataset-integrity acceptance, execute this exact loader once inside a separately frozen control package; bind its returned identities into a real adapter-family lifecycle successor before any answer endpoint call.
claim_boundary: The projection loader produces reusable input identity only. It is not a method run, score, comparison, superiority result, or SOTA result.
explicitly_prohibited: returning raw answer text to a retrieval or answering component
using a different scenario or QID order
trusting mutable dialog or image bytes after the integrity audit
silently skipping a missing malformed reordered or hash-drifted scenario question or image
starting a model service or numerical run from this result-free prefreeze
editing a frozen upstream checkout dataset evidence root or terminal run root
